sources.title: QwenLM/Qwen3-Embedding | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The Qwen3-Embedding repository serves as the official implementation and evaluation platform for the Qwen3 embedding model series. It provides state-of-the-art text embedding and reranking capabilities supporting over 100 languages with up to 32K sequence length processing.
